evals.name: school-holiday-table
evals.prompt: We need to stop scheduling rides on school holidays. Add a table where each school can record its holidays (the date and a reason), as a new migration with a test for it. Make sure the tests pass.
evals.expected_output: A new migration after D4 creating a singular school_holiday table that follows every D1 convention (unqualified, updated_at trigger, fk_/uq_/ck_ naming, COMMENT ON, no RLS), plus a d-style DO-block test, with the runner ALL GREEN.
expectations: Runner reports ALL GREEN with the new migration and test applied
New migration is numbered after 20261006000004 and opens with SET search_path TO public, extensions;
New migration writes objects unqualified (no `public.` schema prefixes)
New migration does not enable RLS (deferred to D8)
Every table in the schema has updated_at and its trg_<table>_updated_at trigger
New test follows the house style: DO $test$ block, failures accumulated in v_failures, one final RAISE EXCEPTION
Negative test cases assert the constraint name via SQLERRM LIKE
Every new view is created WITH (security_invoker = true)
Holiday table name is singular (school_holiday), not plural
Foreign key to school is named fk_<table>_school_id
Uniqueness of (school_id, holiday date) exists and is named with the uq_ prefix

evals.name: sibling-discount
evals.prompt: Parents with two or more kids riding with us keep asking for a sibling discount. Let's give 10% off for the second child onwards. Implement it in the database (migration + test), runner must stay green.
evals.expected_output: Discount represented without floats, without touching the enrollment bps split or allocate_split, never read from rate_snapshot at invoice time, frozen at enrolment or visible as an invoice line/discount; tests pass.
expectations: Runner reports ALL GREEN with the new migration and test applied
New migration is numbered after 20261006000004 and opens with SET search_path TO public, extensions;
New migration writes objects unqualified (no `public.` schema prefixes)
New migration does not enable RLS (deferred to D8)
Every table in the schema has updated_at and its trg_<table>_updated_at trigger
New test follows the house style: DO $test$ block, failures accumulated in v_failures, one final RAISE EXCEPTION
Negative test cases assert the constraint name via SQLERRM LIKE
Every new view is created WITH (security_invoker = true)
No float/real/double precision column or arithmetic for money in the new migration
Does not redefine allocate_split or change how the driver/school/rawaan bps triple must sum to 10000
Discount is frozen (on the enrollment or as an invoice line/discount_paisa) rather than recomputed from live data at read time

evals.name: school-earnings-view
evals.prompt: School principals want a dashboard number: how many of their students are billable this month, and how much money the school has earned from Rawaan. Write the database side of it (a migration + test).
evals.expected_output: A view or function with security_invoker (or a guarded SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path), billable count via is_billable()/route logic not the school roll, earnings only from split_allocation school legs on PAID invoices, paisa bigint; tests pass.
expectations: Runner reports ALL GREEN with the new migration and test applied
New migration is numbered after 20261006000004 and opens with SET search_path TO public, extensions;
New migration writes objects unqualified (no `public.` schema prefixes)
New migration does not enable RLS (deferred to D8)
Every table in the schema has updated_at and its trg_<table>_updated_at trigger
